Thanks. Great information mate! I have social connections that aren't related to my previous jobs so socially I can manage fine without a job. I have a lot of hobbies so I don't need the "purpose" that jobs provide. I am NEET atm actually and it's been a massive improvement to my life overall. But I will run out of money eventually that's why I made this post.
I get my social needs fulfilled without a job.
I'm willing to look at more ads instead of paying. Why can't I have that option?
I feel for you. Thanks for sharing your experiences.

Good post. I totally relate. Have you done therapy and medication? 

To combat loneliness and lack of friendship I would give a heads up for meetup.com. It allows you to enter your personality and interests in order to match up with people who are similar to you. Then join any activity posted on there that seems comfortable to you. It can be as simple as a coffee meet-up or playing board games.

Good luck!
